definitions.explanation: The body of law that defines criminal offenses and their punishments. In Japan, refers specifically to the Penal Code (刑法典) enacted in 1907.

examples.japanese: {刑法|けいほう}に{違反|いはん}する。
その{行為|こうい}は{刑法|けいほう}で{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: That act is prohibited under criminal law.

examples.japanese: {刑法|けいほう}の{改正案|かいせいあん}が{国会|こっかい}で{審議|しんぎ}されている。
examples.english: A bill to amend the penal code is being deliberated in the Diet.

notes:
USAGE:
{刑法|けいほう} specifically covers criminal offenses and penalties, as opposed to {民法|みんぽう} (civil law) which governs private disputes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刑法|けいほう}に{違反|いはん}する (to violate criminal law)
- {刑法|けいほう}{改正|かいせい} (amendment of the penal code)
- {刑法|けいほう}{犯|はん} (criminal offense)
- {刑法|けいほう}{学|がく} (criminal law studies)
